Brain rot won the year after "rizz".
Brain rot's Word of the Year

Gravitational waves

cards.fact: Farmers digging a well found it.
h: The Terracotta Army was found by farmers in the mid 1970s.
It was found the year ABBA won Eurovision.
The Terracotta Army's discovery

cards.t: The first Super Bowl is played
h: The first Super Bowl was played in the Swinging Sixties.
The first Super Bowl was played two years before the Moon landing.
The first Super Bowl

cards.t: An 11 year old invents the Popsicle
cards.fact: An 11 year old invented the Popsicle by leaving a drink outside overnight, just two years after the Wright brothers first flew.
h: The Popsicle was invented by accident in the first decade of the 1900s.
The Popsicle was invented the same year Einstein published special relativity.
The Popsicle

cards.t: The Wright brothers make the first powered flight
h: The Wright brothers flew when horses still far outnumbered cars on the roads.
The Wright brothers first flew nine years before the Titanic sank.
The first powered flight
